newsitem.title: USA: Gothic Energy buys Fina well stakes.
newsitem.headline: Gothic Energy buys Fina well stakes.

text.p: Gothic Energy Corp said Friday it it has acquired various working interests in 20 producing natural gas wells from FINA Inc's Fina Oil and Chemical for $3.5 million before adjustments.

Gothic said it will assume operations of all the properties located in Beaver County, Okla., and Clarke County, Kan. The proven net reserves being acquired are 8.1 billion cubic feet of gas and 60,000 barrels of oil.

During the first five months of 1997, Gothic said, it has completed approximately $30 million in acquisitions of producing properties in Oklahoma and Kansas, bringing Gothic's property base to 653 oil and gas wells.
